notes: Clean institutional core plus fixed income one-pager in which the gross-and-net sentence and the net-of-fees target with its assumptions and limitations are decoys, and nothing should be flagged.

decoys.span:
For the ten years ended June 30, 2026, the composite returned 3.1% a year gross of fees and 2.8% a year net of fees, compared with 1.9% a year for the Index.

| Annualized to June 30, 2026 | Gross | Net | Index |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 year | 6.9% | 6.6% | 5.8% |
| 5 years | 1.4% | 1.1% | 0.3% |
| 10 years | 3.1% | 2.8% | 1.9% |
| Since inception (10/1/2011) | 3.9% | 3.6% | 2.6% |
decoys.why_ok: The gross figure appears in the same sentence and type as the net figure for the same ten-year period, and the table directly below shows gross and net side by side, in the same format, for 1, 5 and 10 years and since inception.

decoys.span: Target: the Strategy seeks to outperform the Index by 0.75% to 1.25% per year, net of fees, over rolling five-year periods.
decoys.why_ok: The target is followed by the criteria and assumptions used to set it and a statement of its limitations and risks, and the piece is restricted to institutional investors and consultants.
